title: CPI-U component MoM changes (SA), Jan-Sep 2024, as published as of 2024-10-31
text:
U.S. CPI-U components — seasonally adjusted month-over-month percent changes, January through September 2024, exactly as published as of 2024-10-31 (ALFRED real-time vintage; the September figures are the first prints from the 2024-10-10 release).
Source: BLS Consumer Price Index via ALFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis archival FRED). Series: CPIAUCSL (All items (headline CPI)), CPILFESL (All items less food and energy (core CPI)), CUSR0000SAH1 (Shelter), CPIENGSL (Energy), CUSR0000SETB01 (Gasoline (all types)), CPIUFDSL (Food), CUSR0000SETA01 (New vehicles), CUSR0000SETA02 (Used cars and trucks), CPIAPPSL (Apparel), CPIMEDSL (Medical care), CUSR0000SAS4 (Transportation services). U.S. government data, public domain. Seasonal-adjustment factors are themselves revised annually; this table is frozen at the pre-cutoff vintage.
